code:
- hosts: web
  become: true
  vars:
    domain: {{domain}}
    email: {{email}}
  tasks:
    - name: install nginx and certbot
      apt:
        name: [nginx, certbot, python3-certbot-nginx]
        update_cache: yes
    - name: ensure nginx running
      service: { name: nginx, state: started, enabled: yes }
    - name: obtain LE cert
      command: >
        certbot --nginx -n --agree-tos --redirect
        -d {{ domain }} -m {{ email }}
      args:
        creates: /etc/letsencrypt/live/{{ domain }}/fullchain.pem
summary_zh: Ansible 裝 nginx 並用 certbot 簽 LE 憑證
